name: Loren
description: An elven master-scout under attack by the druid Morgan and thallids whom Tev helped.

description_citations.text: "Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Morgan traps Loren with several Thallids to ensure his mission fails.
timeline.quote: Morgan having a long-standing family feud with Loren relishes this opportunity and traps Loren with several Thallids creatures.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev destroys the Thallids with a Fireball but leaves, and Morgan kills Loren with a poisoned arrow.
timeline.quote: Tev moves on as Morgan strikes Loren down with a poisoned arrow killing him.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev's planeswalker spark ignites and his appearance turns draconic as he declares himself the Doom of All Fools; he incinerates thallids attacking Loren.
timeline.quote: As his Planeswalker spark ignited, his grip on humanity began to slip
